title: BYU Racing Live Telemetry & Data Analysis
summary: Live CAN and GPS telemetry, visualization, and analysis for BYU Racing's Formula SAE car.
focus: CAN / GPS / Data Transfer / Web analytics
overview: Vehicle CAN data and GPS measurements feed a Raspberry Pi through a CAN HAT and GPS module. An LTE HAT streams CAN and corrected GPS data over WebSocket to the AVA web application. FastAPI handles the backend and CANDB conversion, React displays live data, and PostgreSQL stores data for later analysis.
components: Raspberry Pi with LTE HAT, CAN HAT, and GPS module.
Raspberry Pi base station with GPS module for RTK GPS corrections.
FastAPI backend and CANDB for data conversion.
React frontend for live visualization and saved-data analysis.

diagram.alt: CAN and GPS are received by a Raspberry Pi; LTE connects to FastAPI, React displays live data, PostgreSQL saves data for analysis, and an RTK base supplies GPS corrections.
